title: Rav Hinak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 101b: Rav Idi bar Avin said to Rav Chisda, “So we learned it in the baraita of the school of Rav Hinak — and some say, in the baraita of the school of Bar Hinak — as you say.”[^1]

notes.text: The opening three paragraphs of the consulted Pesachim 101b show Rav Idi bar Avin before Rav Chisda, who reports Rav Huna’s teaching. Idi then gives the school-of-Rav-Hinak or school-of-Bar-Hinak baraita. Huna is the reported teacher here, not a replacement for Chisda as Idi’s addressee.
